title: Unit 19 Consolidation: Center vs. Periphery: Spatial Inequalities & Rural Transformations
goal: I can describe Budapest's weight, transport poverty and the shortage of doctors and teachers in villages.
I can use images of inequality, contrast two sides with *míg ... addig*, and state a purpose.
I can say how sure a judgement is and whose it is.
